# Where to Watch War At Your Door


by Angel | August 20, 2026


What would you do if 147 children were depending on you—and war was closing in?


When civil war erupts across South Sudan, missionary Carolyn Figlioli finds herself trapped with the children in her care, with food running out and no safe way to leave. With every escape route blocked, she faces an impossible challenge: get the children to safety before it’s too late.


[Watch all six episodes of War At Your Door now, exclusively on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/war-at-your-door)


### **147 Children. One Impossible Mission.**


Carolyn Figlioli didn’t expect to find herself at the center of a war zone.


But when violence erupts across South Sudan, she's suddenly trapped with 147 children. The situation becomes more dangerous by the hour as food supplies disappear, violence draws closer, and the government prevents them from leaving.


There is no simple solution and no guarantee that help will arrive.


Carolyn knows that staying could put everyone in greater danger. But leaving the children behind isn’t an option.


### **When There Is Nowhere Safe to Go**


As the crisis escalates, Carolyn and those around her must navigate a rapidly changing situation with the lives of the children hanging in the balance. And every decision carries enormous consequences.


With limited resources and no clear path to safety, the group is forced to keep going even when the odds seem impossible. What follows is a remarkable story of courage and determination as Carolyn risks everything to protect the children entrusted to her.


### **A True Story of Courage and Faith**


*War At Your Door* goes beyond the headlines to tell the story of the people caught in the middle of a conflict—and one woman who refused to abandon those who needed her most.


The six-episode documentary series captures the fear and uncertainty of the crisis while highlighting the faith, sacrifice, and compassion that emerge in the midst of it.


For viewers, the story offers a glimpse into a reality that many people around the world may never experience firsthand. As one Guild member shared, watching the series “made me realize how unaware I have been of what life is like for people in less fortunate communities.”


### **When Love Means Taking a Risk**


At the center of *War At Your Door* is a simple but powerful choice: Carolyn could have focused on getting herself to safety, but she chose to fight for the children in her care.


Her story is a reminder that courage doesn’t always look like having no fear. Sometimes it means moving forward despite the fear because someone else is counting on you.


The result is an award-winning documentary series about faith, sacrifice, and the extraordinary things ordinary people can do when they refuse to give up.


### **Watch** ***War At Your Door*** **on Angel**


With six episodes documenting a remarkable story of courage in the face of unimaginable circumstances, *War At Your Door* is a powerful reminder of what can happen when compassion refuses to back down.


[Stream all six episodes of War At Your Door today, exclusively on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/war-at-your-door)
